title: Slow English Practice | Airport ESSENTIALS for traveling ✈️

sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast. Today.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。今天。

sentences.en: We are at the airport.
sentences.tc: 我們在機場。

sentences.en: We are going to take a flight. Join us. The automatic doors slide open and right away.
sentences.tc: 我們要搭飛機了。加入我們。自動門立即滑開。

sentences.en: You see the FIDS board, the flight information display system where you can see your flight status, whether it's on time, delayed, or cancelled.
sentences.tc: 您會看到 FIDS 板，這是一個航班資訊顯示系統，您可以在其中查看航班狀態，無論是準時、延誤還是取消。

sentences.en: We found our checkin counter.
sentences.tc: 我們找到了報到櫃檯。

sentences.en: We were flying with Air Asia,.
sentences.tc: 我們搭乘的是亞洲航空的航班。

sentences.en: We had to find the Air Asia checkin counter.
sentences.tc: 我們必須找到亞洲航空報到櫃檯。

sentences.en: I am in line to check in. Some people prefer the selfch checkin kiosk, but I don't like this selfcheckin system as much.
sentences.tc: 我正在排隊辦理登機手續。有些人喜歡自助辦理登機手續亭，但我不太喜歡這種自助登機系統。

sentences.en: Sometimes it makes me nervous. I prefer to check in at a counter with a real person. What about you?
sentences.tc: 有時這讓我緊張。我更喜歡在櫃檯與真人一起辦理登機手續。你呢？

sentences.en: Do you prefer the checkin counter or the selfch checkckin kiosk? >>?
sentences.tc: 您喜歡報到櫃檯還是自助報到亭？ >>？

sentences.en: I am taking the escalator, the electric stairs. You can also take the elevator, but only.
sentences.tc: 我搭乘自動扶梯，電動樓梯。您也可以搭乘電梯，但僅限。

sentences.en: If you need it. Maybe.
sentences.tc: 如果你需要的話。或許。

sentences.en: If you have big luggage or you're in a wheelchair, but it's exclusive for people who need the elevator. I'm okay with taking the escalator, the electric stairs.
sentences.tc: 如果您有大件行李或坐在輪椅上，但它是專門為需要電梯的人提供的。我可以搭乘自動扶梯、電動樓梯。

sentences.en: We got some lunch before our flight.
sentences.tc: 我們在起飛前吃了午餐。

sentences.en: We were close to international arrivals,.
sentences.tc: 我們離國際航班很近。

sentences.en: We had to get to international departures.
sentences.tc: 我們必須前往國際出發航班。

sentences.en: We were departing, not arriving. I got my passport ready and my ticket.
sentences.tc: 我們正在出發，而不是到達。我已經準備好護照和機票了。

sentences.en: We passed through the security checkpoint where you have to take out anything metal like keys, bracelets, coins or change, your computer or laptop, your phone, your headphones.
sentences.tc: 我們通過了安​​全檢查站，你必須取出任何金屬物品，如鑰匙、手鐲、硬幣或零錢、你的電腦或筆記型電腦、你的手機、你的耳機。

sentences.en: Sometimes even your shoes. The queue or line was very long, but once.
sentences.tc: 有時甚至是你的鞋子。隊列很長，但有一次。

sentences.en: We got through security,.
sentences.tc: 我們通過了安​​檢，。

sentences.en: They're super expensive,.
sentences.tc: 它們超級貴，。

sentences.en: I like looking through each store while I wait.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡在等待的時候瀏覽每家商店。

sentences.en: We walk past Cartiier and Starbucks as.
sentences.tc: 我們走過卡地亞和星巴克。
